messages:
Marta Li: Hey team — quick ping. Samir Patel is starting on-call shadowing next week and I want to coordinate who pairs with him for primary/secondary handoffs and live paging drills. Samir, welcome! Can you confirm your availability for shadow shifts (PST)?

Samir Patel: Thanks Marta! Happy to be here. I can do Mon/Wed afternoons PST and most Fridays. Prefer pairing with someone who handles infra incidents (timeouts, OOMs).

Aisha Khan: Welcome @Samir! I can do Wed afternoons and Friday mornings. I can walk through our common mitigations for high-latency and model-fallbacks. Also happy to be your primary for first two live pages.

Jorge Ruiz: Add me — I usually cover the 00:00–08:00 UTC window and can demo the reroute policy and emergency scale runbook. FYI the rotation spreadsheet is up to date: https://redwood.internal/oncall/rotation (read-only).

Marta Li: Great. Proposed plan: Week 1 shadow schedule:
 - Mon: Samir shadows Aisha (15:00–18:00 PST) — focus: paging flow, Slack incident bot, initial triage.
 - Wed: Samir shadows Jorge (15:00–18:00 PST) — focus: routing, autoscale runbook.
 - Fri: Samir sits in the 08:00–12:00 PST overlap with Aisha for handoff practice.

Aisha Khan: Sounds good. A couple of runbook pointers for Samir before first shift:
 - Paging policy: pages for p50 latency > 900ms sustained for 3m, and error rate > 1% over 5m.
 - Escalation matrix: primary -> secondary (ping on Slack) -> oncall lead -> pagerduty escalation.
 - Quick triage checklist:
   1. Check service health dashboard (console.redwood/health)
   2. Confirm scope: model, infra, or downstream client
   3. If infra, run the hotspot script:
```
#!/bin/bash
# show top GPU mem processes
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv | head
# tail the runtime logs
tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/runtime.log
```
   4. If model timeout, enable fallback-to-quantized: POST /admin/route/fallback {"route":"/chat", "fallback_model":"redwood-quant-1"}

Samir Patel: Thanks for the checklist. Quick Q: where's the canonical runbook for incident severity scoring?

Jorge Ruiz: It's linked in the runbook index but here you go: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/severity.md — TL;DR: sev1 = customer-facing outage (>=50% errors or total downtime > 5m), sev2 = degraded experience for subset, sev3 = minor/observability. When in doubt escalate.

incident-bot: [automated] Reminder: New on-call shadowing session scheduled by Marta Li • 2026-03-18 23:45 UTC • Attendees: Samir Patel, Aisha Khan. See /oncall calendar for details.

Marta Li: A few operational notes for handoffs and coverage gaps:
 - Please post a handoff message in #eng-oncall with the following template at shift boundary:
   *Current status:* [green/yellow/red]
   *Active incidents:* [link(s) or "none"]
   *Actions in progress:* [short bullets]
 - If you're covering outside your normal window, update the rotation sheet and ping me so we can adjust secondary coverage.
 - For the first two live pages, Aisha will be primary, Jorge secondary. After that Samir will take a supervised primary page (Aisha on standby).

Aisha Khan: One more thing — during shadowing you'll get a suppressed page (test) and then we'll run a live drill where the pager is real but Jorge will be available to observe. Plan for 10–15 minute response and verbalize your triage steps in the channel.

Samir Patel: Got it. Any tips for dealing with model-quality regressions?

Jorge Ruiz: For quality regressions: check the eval dashboard (console.redwood/evals), run the quick-repro script to reproduce locally, and if it's model drift open a model-rollout ticket and fallback to previous pinned model. Repro script:
```
python tools/repro.py --trace 12345 --model redwood-v2
```
Also add a short note to the incident thread with sample inputs/outputs.

Marta Li: Action items:
 - Samir: Confirm availability for the proposed slots (Mon/Wed/Fri) — reply here.
 - Aisha/Jorge: Please add 30m each to your calendars for a shadow retro after week 1.
 - Everyone: Bookmark the runbook links and ensure PagerDuty contact numbers are correct.

Samir Patel: Confirmed for Mon/Wed/Fri windows. Looking forward — and thanks for the onboarding checklist.

Aisha Khan: Welcome aboard @Samir — I'll DM you the quick tips doc and we'll do a short pre-shift 10m call before Monday. :wave:

Jorge Ruiz: If anyone wants to run the live paging drill earlier, I can trigger a synthetic alert Tuesday 17:30 PST. Say the word.

Marta Li: Perfect — we'll start with Monday shadow and schedule the synthetic drill for Tuesday if Samir is comfortable. Closing the loop: I'll post the finalized schedule to the rotation sheet and pin this thread to #eng-oncall for future shadow reference. :white_check_mark:
